pairs.target: tóu yìzhāng cǎogǎo fàngdào huòzhàn zhuōshàng shí , mù guǎn shìxiān kànjiàn liǎngtiáolù . tā yòng zhǐjié zài ménqián nà yì jié qīngqīng qiāo le liǎngxià , wèn shìbushì sònglái de rén hái dé zìjǐ xuǎn .
pairs.english: When the first draft reached the warehouse table, Steward Mou noticed two routes. He tapped the section before his gate twice, asking whether arrivals still had to choose for themselves.
pairs.hanzi: 头一张草稿放到货栈桌上时，牟管事先看见两条路。他用指节在门前那一截轻轻敲了两下，问是不是送来的人还得自己选。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō shì . dào huòzhàn xiējiǎo de , wǎng ménqián ; qù nánàn jiē chuán de , búbì zài bèizhe xíngli dōu huílái .
pairs.english: Nerai said yes. Resting at the warehouse meant its gate; south-bank ferry passengers needn't carry luggage on that detour.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说是。到货栈歇脚的，往门前；去南岸接船的，不必再背着行李兜回来。

pairs.target: tā jiāng chá guò de rìqī yǔ shuǐwèi yíbìng zhǐ gěi tā , bú jiào tā bǎ yìzhāng tú ná chéng měi yíjì dōu kěyòng de bǎozhèng .
pairs.english: She pointed out the survey date and water level, not letting him take one map as a guarantee for every season.
pairs.hanzi: 她将查过的日期与水位一并指给他，不叫他把一张图拿成每一季都可用的保证。

pairs.target: jǐjiā yìzhàn pài lái shōu tú de huǒjì xìng lián , dài zhe yìzhī zhuāng zhǐ de biǎn mùhé . tā bǎ hézi gēxià , xiān wènhòu chuán de dìfāng shuí guǎn , ruò yǔtiān lái yìchē rén , shìfǒu yǒurén dāying gěi tāmen liú péngzǐ .
pairs.english: The stations' map collector was named Lian, carrying a flat wooden paper box. Setting it down, he asked who managed waiting areas and whether anyone had promised shelter for a cartful of arrivals in rain.
pairs.hanzi: 几家驿站派来收图的伙计姓连，带着一只装纸的扁木盒。他把盒子搁下，先问候船的地方谁管，若雨天来一车人，是否有人答应给他们留棚子。

pairs.target: mù guǎnshì shuō huòzhàn qián yán néng jiè yíbàn , bùnéng lián huò yě jiào tā quán nuózǒu ; tā yě chūlì , tú shàng biàn gāi ràng lái de rén kàndéjiàn .
pairs.english: Steward Mou could lend half the warehouse eaves, but shouldn't have to move all the freight too. He was contributing; the map should make him visible to arrivals.
pairs.hanzi: 牟管事说货栈前檐能借一半，不能连货也叫他全挪走；他也出力，图上便该让来的人看得见。

pairs.target: lú shí zhèng gǎn dìèr bānchuán yǐqián de kòngdāng , tīngjiàn zhèhuà , shuō zìjǐ méi jiào rén bú kàn huòzhàn , zhǐshì huà dào zìjiā bóchuán kǒu , bié yòu tì tā niáng jiāng shài yútái xǔ gěi suǒyǒurén .
pairs.english: Lushi, free before her second crossing, said she wasn't hiding the warehouse; just don't draw her family mooring as if her mother's fish-drying platform belonged to everyone.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实正赶第二班船以前的空当，听见这话，说自己没叫人不看货栈，只是画到自家泊船口，别又替她娘将晒鱼台许给所有人。

pairs.target: lián huǒjì zài zhǐbiān jìxià yíjù , tíngbǐ wèn , nà nánàn lián yígè xiàyǔ néng děng de dìfāng yě méiyǒu ? " yǒu àn , yǒu lù . " lú shí shuō , " péngzǐ hái méiyǒu . "
pairs.english: Lian noted that, then asked if the south bank lacked even a place to wait in rain. “There's a bank and a path,” Lushi said. “No shelter yet.”
pairs.hanzi:
连伙计在纸边记下一句，停笔问，那南岸连一个下雨能等的地方也没有？
“有岸，有路。”芦实说，“棚子还没有。”

pairs.target: huà dào zhèlǐ , zhuōshàng de tú hūrán xiǎnde hěn báo . tǎ wéi zuótiānxiàwǔ zǒu dé guòqù , bìngbùděngyú jīnrì lái le rén , jiù yǒurén bǎ péngzǐ , zuò chù hé xià yìbān chuán quán tì tāmen bǎihǎo .
pairs.english: The map suddenly seemed thin. Tavi's walking there yesterday didn't mean today's arrivals would find shelter, seats, and the next ferry all arranged for them.
pairs.hanzi: 话到这里，桌上的图忽然显得很薄。塔维昨天下午走得过去，并不等于今日来了人，就有人把棚子、坐处和下一班船全替他们摆好。

pairs.target: lián huǒjì shuō jǐjiā yìzhàn hé chū de zhèbǐ qián , shì xiānchá lù huàtú , búshì yǐjīng bō le jiàn péng de qián . shuí ruò zài tú shàng huà gè dǐng , hòutou zhǎo tā yào dǐng de kěbù zhī yígè rén .
pairs.english: Lian said the stations had funded a route survey and map, not shelter construction. Draw a roof and more than one person would come asking him for that roof.
pairs.hanzi: 连伙计说几家驿站合出的这笔钱，是先查路画图，不是已经拨了建棚的钱。谁若在图上画个顶，后头找他要顶的可不只一个人。

pairs.target: mù guǎnshì jiāng shǒu shōuhuí lái , wèn nánàn shìfǒu gāncuì xiān bié xiě . tǎ wéi wàng zhe nàge kòng dìfāng , xiǎngqǐ zuówǎn zìjǐ yánlù rèn huílái de gǎnjué , biàn shuō nàlǐ quèshí néng jiē chuán , ruò zhī xiě huòzhàn , xīn lái de rén hái huì yǐwéi dōu dé rào ménkǒu .
pairs.english: Steward Mou withdrew his hand and asked if they should omit the south bank for now. Remembering finding his way yesterday, Tavi said boats did connect there; showing only the warehouse would suggest everyone must detour to its gate.
pairs.hanzi: 牟管事将手收回来，问南岸是否干脆先别写。塔维望着那个空地方，想起昨晚自己沿路认回来的感觉，便说那里确实能接船，若只写货栈，新来的人还会以为都得绕门口。

pairs.target: tā běnlái zhī shuō le bànjù , wūlǐ jǐgè rén què dōu kàn tā , xiàng děng tā jiāng hòutou de péngzǐ yě bānchūlái .
pairs.english: He'd only half-spoken, but everyone looked as though waiting for him to produce the shelter too.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来只说了半句，屋里几个人却都看他，像等他将后头的棚子也搬出来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tíng le yíxià , jiēzhe shuō zìjǐ zhī zǒuguò tú shàng zhè yíduàn , méi jiàn guò yǔpéng , yě méi wèn dào shuíkěn ràng wū , bùnéng tìrén shuō yǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi paused, then said he'd walked only this mapped section, seen no shelter, and found no offer of a room. He couldn't claim one for someone else.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维停了一下，接着说自己只走过图上这一段，没见过雨棚，也没问到谁肯让屋，不能替人说有。

pairs.target: lián huǒjì diǎntóu , wèn jìrán liǎngbiān dōu yào xiě , kōng chù fàng shénme . tǎ wéi jiāng bǐ dìgěi nài lěi , méi shēnshǒu tì tā dìng zì .
pairs.english: Lian nodded: if both routes were shown, what went in the blank? Tavi passed Nerai the pen rather than choosing her words.
pairs.hanzi: 连伙计点头，问既然两边都要写，空处放什么。塔维将笔递给奈蕾，没伸手替她定字。

pairs.target: tā zài nánàn jiē lùpáng xiěmíng wú zhēyǔ chù , wèn chuán xiān dào ànshàng dàngrì guàpái chù ; huòzhàn ménqián zé lìng zhù kě hòu rén , huòwù rù zhàn lìngyì , bù bǎ děng chuán tóng zhùdiàn hùn zài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: She labeled the southern connection no rain shelter, inquire at today's shore noticeboard; the warehouse gate could be used for waiting, freight storage separately agreed. Waiting for a boat wasn't lodging at an inn.
pairs.hanzi: 她在南岸接路旁写明无遮雨处，问船先到岸上当日挂牌处；货栈门前则另注可候人，货物入栈另议，不把等船同住店混在一起。

pairs.target: mù guǎnshì kàn le yíhuìer , shuō zì jiāménkǒu zhè jù dǎo búbì duǒ dé zhème xiǎo . nài lěi jiāng zì fàngdà , lián huǒjì què bǎ liǎngchù de zì dōu liáng le liáng , shuō tā huíqù dé jiāodài wèishénme búshì yìtiáo dà jiàntóu .
pairs.english: Mou studied it and said his gate's caption needn't hide so small. Nerai enlarged it; Lian measured both captions, saying he'd have to explain why there wasn't one big arrow.
pairs.hanzi: 牟管事看了一会儿，说自家门口这句倒不必躲得这么小。奈蕾将字放大，连伙计却把两处的字都量了量，说他回去得交代为什么不是一条大箭头。

pairs.target: lú shí xiào , shuō nà jiù jiào chūqián de rén yě lái zǒu yìhuí , tā biàn shuō zìjǐ jīnrì lái jiùshì zǒu , bùrán bào mùhé chūlái zuò shénme .
pairs.english: Lushi laughed: have the payers walk it too. He said that was why he'd come today; why else carry a wooden box out here?
pairs.hanzi: 芦实笑，说那就叫出钱的人也来走一回，他便说自己今日来就是走，不然抱木盒出来做什么。

pairs.target: wǔhòu lián huǒjì zhēn suí tǎ wéi zǒu le liǎngduàn . qù nánàn shí xiédǐ cèng le ní , tā méi guài tú , xiān tíngxiàlái bǎ xié biān guā jìng , zài wèn nǎlǐ zhuǎnshēn néng bú zhuàng zhe bān kuāng de rén .
pairs.english: That afternoon Lian really walked both stretches with Tavi. Mud on his soles didn't make him blame the map; he scraped his shoes, then asked where he could turn without hitting basket carriers.
pairs.hanzi: 午后连伙计真随塔维走了两段。去南岸时鞋底蹭了泥，他没怪图，先停下来把鞋边刮净，再问哪里转身能不撞着搬筐的人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǐ gěi tā kàn zuórì děng shuǐtǒng de qiángbiān , liǎng rén tuìhuí bànbù , gānghǎo ràng yìzhī cháng kuāng cóng zhōngjiān guòqù .
pairs.english: Tavi showed yesterday's wall-side waiting spot; they stepped back half a step to let a long basket pass between.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维指给他看昨日等水桶的墙边，两人退回半步，刚好让一只长筐从中间过去。

pairs.target: huílái yǐhòu , lián huǒjì méi shuō liǎngtiáolù yíyàng hǎo , zhī zài huízhí lǐ xiě liǎngchù dāngqián kěxíng , nánàn hòuchuán shèshī shàngquē , yǔtiān yòngfǎ dàibǔ chá .
pairs.english: Back, Lian didn't call both routes equally good. His receipt said both currently usable, southern waiting facilities lacking, rainy-weather use requiring further checks.
pairs.hanzi: 回来以后，连伙计没说两条路一样好，只在回执里写两处当前可行，南岸候船设施尚缺，雨天用法待补查。

pairs.target: zhèxiē huà tóng cǎogǎo yìqǐ fàngjìn mùhé , nài lěi liú le fùběn , fùqīng zhuǎnsòng yóu jiǎo , qǐng tā zhào yuē dàigěi jǐjiā wěituō de yìzhàn .
pairs.english: These words and the draft went into the box. Nerai kept a copy, paid forwarding postage, and asked him to deliver it to the commissioning stations as agreed.
pairs.hanzi: 这些话同草稿一起放进木盒，奈蕾留了副本，付清转送邮脚，请他照约带给几家委托的驿站。

pairs.target: cǎogǎo sòngzǒu , bìng méiyǒu shuí zài ànbiān duō dā chū yípiàn wūyán . lú shí zhào zìjǐ de chuán cì zǒu le , mù guǎnshì zhuǎnshēn qù jiē yìpī yāhuài jiǎo de zhǐbāo , lín chūmén yòu huítóu jiào tǎ wéi xiàhuí bié bǎ huòzhàn huà dé xiàng gè huì chī rén de zuǐ .
pairs.english: Sending the draft built no extra shelter ashore. Lushi left for her scheduled crossing, Mou to receive crushed-corner paper parcels, turning at the door to tell Tavi not to draw the warehouse like a man-eating mouth next time.
pairs.hanzi: 草稿送走，并没有谁在岸边多搭出一片屋檐。芦实照自己的船次走了，牟管事转身去接一批压坏角的纸包，临出门又回头叫塔维下回别把货栈画得像个会吃人的嘴。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhēng le yíxià , nài lěi xiān xiào , zhǐzhe tā huà wāi de mén yán , shuō zhèhuí dǎo shì nǐ zìjǐ de shǒuyì .
pairs.english: Tavi stared; Nerai laughed first, pointing at his crooked eaves: this time it really was his handiwork.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维怔了一下，奈蕾先笑，指着他画歪的门檐，说这回倒是你自己的手艺。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn tǎ wéi zhòng kàn liúdǐ , fāxiàn tú shàng zuì jǐ de dìfāng búshì jiù shíyǎn , shì nà liǎngchù xiě le rén kěyǐ děng , què hái bù yíyàng de kòngdì .
pairs.english: That evening Tavi reread the copy. The most crowded parts weren't the old stone opening, but those two different spaces where people could wait.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚塔维重看留底，发现图上最挤的地方不是旧石眼，是那两处写了人可以等、却还不一样的空地。

pairs.target: tā jiāng zhǐ gē hǎo , méiyǒu yīnwèi yǐjīng jìchūqù yìzhāng , biàn jiāng yúxià jǐyè yě yìtóng juǎn qǐlái .
pairs.english: He put it away without rolling up all the remaining pages just because one sheet had been sent.
pairs.hanzi: 他将纸搁好，没有因为已经寄出去一张，便将余下几页也一同卷起来。
